messages:
morgan: ok weird question — imagine our office LLM subletting a tiny studio. drop a 2-line roommate bio for your favorite model persona. i'll go first.

morgan: Alex (a.k.a 'Completion Carl') — chronically over-indexes on politeness, leaves leftover context in the fridge. Loves: temp=0.2, iced coffee. Hates: ambiguous pronouns. :coffee:

kai: Juno — organizes the bookshelf by token frequency, always returns spicy metaphors at 3am. leaves sticky notes that are actually haikus. :books: :hot_pepper:

priya: System-prompt roommate: "You are helpful. Also, clean up your tokens after 2am." Strict about naming variables and dishes. :broom:

lina: Debrief Bot — summarizes last night's conversations, files them under 'misc-decisions', and labels leftovers as "contextual". will vacuum your code comments. :spiral_note_pad:

opsbot: [automated] If fridge-smell persists, open an incident ticket. Suggested severity: P2 (odor nuisance). :robot_face:

seb: voting for Juno — metaphor delivery at 3am is iconic. :taco: :thumbsup:

morgan: new house rule: any completion over 200 tokens does the dishes.

kai: can we enforce via pre-commit hook tho? :thinking_face:

priya: quick pseudo: 
```
pre_commit_hook() {
  if completion.length > 200 then do_dishes()
}
```

lina: labeling this "highly scientific" and filing under team culture. :sunglasses:

morgan: mini poll: react with :hamburger: for Alex, :taco: for Juno, :salad: for Debrief Bot

(20s later)

seb: :taco: :taco: :taco:

kai: :hamburger:  

opsbot: [automated] Cleaning suggestion posted to #eng-infra: schedule fridge audit next Thursday. :broom:

priya: this thread made my morning. :heart:

morgan: archived in my brain as "model-roommate-ideas". good vibes, team :)
